ValidationRule.description: If Credit Pre-Screening Result = Accept then Credit Bureau Score and Credit Bureau Risk Rating is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, "Accept"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Approved_Requested_Card_Type__c, "PLATINUM_BALANCE_TRANSFER_01"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Bureau_Risk_Rating__c, ""), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Credit Bureau Risk Rating fields.
